#include <iostream>

long long int repunit[18];
int best = 0;

void search(int cost, long long int remainder, int len) {
    if (cost > best) return;
    if (remainder == 0) {
        best = min(cost, best);
        return;
    }
    int cnt = remainder / repunit[len];
    search(cost + (len * cnt++), remainder - (cnt * repunit[len]), len - 1);
    search(len * cnt + cost, cnt * repunit[len] - remainder, len - 1);
}

int main() {
    long long int n;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    repunit[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < 18; i++)
        repunit[i] = 10 * repunit[i - 1] + 1;
    long long int temp = n;
    while (temp > 0) {
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            if (repunit[i] > temp) {
                best += (i - 1);
                temp -= repunit[i - 1];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    search(0, n, 16);
    printf("%d\n", best);
    return 0;
}
